sources: Unit prices: rounded estimates for new-build family houses in the Czech Republic in 2026 (materials and labour, CZK without VAT), set by the author from typical contractor price lists and tender price levels. Indicative, not a quotation.

Outdoor works and the pool: typical 2026 offers for cantilever sliding gates with a motor (about 16 000 CZK per metre of opening), slat fences on a precast plinth, concrete block paving, polypropylene pool shells with equipment and an automatic cover, and thermo-ash decking; rounded by the author.
The heat pump is priced as a complete set (outdoor unit, indoor unit, hot-water tank, installation and commissioning): its price hardly depends on the rated output.

VAT: the reduced rate of 12 % for the house, its accessories and the PV system on its roof; the standard rate of 21 % for kitchen furniture and appliances, for stand-alone outdoor structures (fence, gates, utility pillar, paved areas of the plot, groundworks and planting) and for the pool (Czech VAT Act 235/2004, sections 48 and 48a, and the tax administration's guidance on housing), indicative.
Orientation band: 45 000 to 65 000 CZK per m2 of heated floor area with VAT, a broad market range for a new turnkey single-storey house of good specification in 2026, the author's judgement.

note.en: Includes a working strip around the house.
